features.title: Precision specialist
features.text: Operatives rely on weapon accuracy and a chosen combat specialty. Some move in close, while others use stealth or keep their distance.

features.title: Aim
features.text: Pick a target to deal extra precision damage with ranged attacks. Plan movement and reloads around those shots, using the tricks granted by your specialization.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 5 → 4.5–5. Aim and precision weapon play support exceptional focused damage.
ratings.defense: 3–4 → 3–4. Mobility and specialization choices influence exposure and defenses.
ratings.support: 2 → 2–3. Selected skills and feats assist allies; the core loop favors personal offense.
ratings.utility: 3.5 → 3.5–4.5. Dexterity skills and specialization tools support infiltration and scouting.
ratings.difficulty: 3 → 3. Aim, reload and movement choices require planning but form a clear loop.
